proposal.summary: IBAN format errors in payment data cause refund payment processing to fail, leading to customer inquiries perceived as long wait times. We examined payment-db refund failures showing five recent IBAN-format failures (E-02), ticket-db response times showing a median of 2 h within the 24‑h SLA (E-01), and stakeholder interviews indicating perceived long wait times (E-03). The release provides customer notification of IBAN-format refund failures and monitoring of IBAN errors in the payment-db, but does not include corrective actions to fix the IBAN data. The release was approved with known limitations because the DEFINE Gate resulted in a CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs (linked to unknown U-U1), the semantic check failed as the scope omits root‑cause corrective actions, VOB‑U‑U1 remains open, and the bank‑api tool is degraded.
